one_line: Kushan emperor of the early 2nd century CE, ruling from Purushapura over a vast realm linking north India and Central Asia.

appearance.age_look: late 30s to early 40s, tall and broad-shouldered with a solid, imposing build
appearance.face: oval face with strong jaw, medium wheatish complexion, straight nose, thick brows, neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, eyes slightly large in anime style with a calm yet resolute gaze, default expression dignified and thoughtful
appearance.hair: dark brown hair, straight and medium length, brushed back from the forehead and gathered into a short, neatly tied topknot at the crown; around the head a simple gold circlet band (no spikes) sitting just above the hairline
appearance.costume: era-accurate Kushan imperial attire: a long-sleeved, knee-length wrap coat/tunic (knee-length caftan) crossing left over right, made of thick wool, rich deep red as the main colour with a narrow gold woven trim along the collar, front edge and cuffs; under it loose off‑white cotton trousers gathered at the ankles; on the feet sturdy mid‑calf leather boots in dark brown with a slight turned-up toe; around the waist a wide leather belt in dark brown with a simple rectangular bronze buckle and a few small round bronze studs; over the shoulders a soft woollen shawl in muted saffron‑yellow draped from the left shoulder across the back and caught at the right hip, hinting at his Indian connections; minimal jewellery: a pair of small gold hoop earrings and a single plain gold armlet on the right forearm worn over the sleeve, no excessive ornaments; fabric surfaces mostly plain, with only subtle geometric border patterns in darker red on the edges of the coat
appearance.signature: a long Kushan-style straight sword with a simple bronze crossguard and rounded pommel, sheathed in a plain dark brown scabbard hanging from his belt at his left hip, his right hand resting lightly on the hilt

ref_desc: Kanishka I is a tall, broad-shouldered Kushan emperor with an oval wheatish face, dark brown topknotted hair and gold circlet, in a deep red knee-length wrap coat with gold trim, off-white trousers, dark brown boots, saffron-yellow shawl, small gold jewellery, and a bronze-hilted sword in a dark brown scabbard at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Kanishka I as a dignified Kushan emperor: a tall, broad-shouldered man in his late thirties to early forties with an oval wheatish face, strong jaw, straight nose, thick brows, large calm eyes, and a neatly trimmed full beard and moustache. His dark brown hair is brushed back and tied into a short topknot at the crown, encircled by a simple smooth gold band resting just above the hairline. He wears a deep red, long-sleeved knee-length wrap coat crossing left over right, made of thick wool with narrow gold trim along the collar, front edge, and cuffs, over loose off-white cotton trousers gathered at the ankles. His sturdy dark brown leather boots reach mid-calf with slightly turned-up toes. A wide dark brown leather belt with a plain bronze buckle and small round studs cinches his waist, and a muted saffron-yellow woollen shawl is draped from his left shoulder across his back to his right hip. Show minimal jewellery: small gold hoop earrings and a single plain gold armlet over his right sleeve. At his left hip hangs a long straight sword in a plain dark brown scabbard, with a simple bronze crossguard and rounded pommel, his right hand resting on the hilt. Use a palette dominated by deep red, gold, off-white, dark brown, and saffron yellow, and present him front, back, and a close-up of the head to clearly display face, hair, costume details, and sword.
